remaining.reason: Separate installed Chrome/Firefox/Safari on macOS and Edge on Windows samples; Playwright engines do not certify these.
Separate iPhone Safari and Android Chrome task; trusted HTTPS, secure context and crypto.randomUUID preflight required.
Native tap/pan/pinch/transition/consumption, OS cancellation/capture loss and disconnect during active input need physical/manual evidence. Existing Chromium CDP regressions remain separate.
Only matrix subcases executed; initial zero-load/fit/reload, thresholds, surrounding-page gestures, clipping boundaries and full topology matrix are outside this bounded slice.

Selector ordering, SVG sizing/stretch/fetch races, every owner/capture/pickability/default/empty/disconnected-region branch, font completion/stylesheet/CSSOM/media and per-map RAF scheduling remain broader coverage.
This build includes production Factory/Buildings only. Representative benchmark remains its separately dated PR #44 evidence; not rerun here.
Mouse interaction does not validate keyboard or assistive navigation; external controls still need manual focus/activation checks.
Keyboard/focus/activation/event ownership contracts and implementation remain open.
Separate profiling task; no timing benchmark or thresholds introduced. Gate also needs agreed numeric/device criteria.
